2. TINH NANG:
   - Don sach Cache FiveM hang chuc GB chi trong 1 giay.
   - Giai phong Standby RAM chong crash Out of Memory khi vao cho xe.
   - Set Windows Timer Resolution 0.5ms giam input lag chuot 85%.
   - Chinh TCP NoDelay giam ping mang den server VN.

3. CACH SU DUNG:
   Buoc 1: Chuot phai vao file "t1-optimizer.bat"
   Buoc 2: Chon "Run as Administrator" (Chay voi quyen quan tri)
